title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1979-11-02
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DR-1 >> Benchmark ADC-1 >> AES >> Sound Devices 722 >> 24/96 WAV
source: 2 x Nakamichi CM-700's => Sony TCD5 >> 37th Row Center on the Pole >> MAC Analog Audience Source: Just in front of SBD (MAC) Media: 2 x Maxell UD-XLII 90 min

ai_review.summary: Good‑balanced recording captures an energetic first set with crowd‑charged Franklin’s Tower and a cosmic jam after Saint Stephen.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers clear, well‑balanced sound that lets the audience’s excitement shine through without drowning out the music. Reviewers rave about the electric atmosphere of the first set—especially the frenzy for Franklin’s Tower, the sing‑along on Tennessee Jed, and the cosmic jam following Saint Stephen. Overall it’s an emotionally moving performance with solid audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 4‑star review praises both show energy and sound clarity; limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is clear and well‑balanced; crowd ambience adds excitement but does not mask the music.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as a palpable wave of energy, with crowd excitement building around key numbers and a particularly cosmic jam after Saint Stephen.
